task.description: Step 0.5 — Issue Registry for WF-03 GH-785 run. The corresponding local ISS file is docs/issues/ISS-0703.json (rco-sync-ref in GH-785 confirms this), currently marked RESOLVED with the fix commit ae0840b3 applied on branch feature/WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815 (later merged to main). The GitHub issue GH-785 is still OPEN because the only unchecked acceptance criterion — 'TEST-RUNNER retry 6 — full PLC integration suite green (TEST-RUNNER will run)' — has not been confirmed yet. Per WF-03 Step 0.5 protocol, this counts as a recurrence of an existing issue: do NOT create a new ISS file. Instead: append a new occurrence to ISS-0703's handoff_history, update ISS-0703.status to REOPENED, and re-run fn:register-issue against the GitHub issue (which should now mark GH-785 as the corresponding tracking issue with a comment linking to this run).
expected_outputs: docs/issues/ISS-0703.json updated with new occurrence entry pointing at this run (WF03-GH785-20260815 / step-05-issue-fixer)
ISS-0703.status set to REOPENED with reopened_at timestamp
ISS-0703.occurrences (or handoff_history) has one new entry recording the WF-03 re-trigger
GitHub issue #785 updated with a comment via gh issue comment noting the verification run (optional — see note below)
acceptance_criteria: A new occurrence entry exists with run_id = 'WF03-GH785-20260815'
No new ISS file is created (this is a recurrence, not a new issue)
gh issue view 785 returns the issue body unchanged (no body rewrite; only a comment is acceptable)
task.note: Per 'No Issue Left Local-Only' directive: if you find any NEW defect while doing this work, file it (ISS file + gh issue create). For GH-785 itself, no fresh defect is being filed — it's already on GitHub as #785. The Step 0.5 action is purely to keep the local registry aligned with the GitHub tracker.

result.summary: Reopened ISS-0703 for the WF-03 verification run on GH-785: the fix is on main via commits 51170eed and 47d4c7c9, but the unchecked acceptance criterion ('TEST-RUNNER retry 6 - full PLC integration suite green') keeps GH-785 OPEN. Per WF-03 Step 0.5 protocol this is a recurrence of an existing tracked issue, so no new ISS file was created. ISS-0703 and the issue index were updated to REOPENED with a new handoff_history entry recording run_id=WF03-GH785-20260815.
